frequency_question: How often do major revenue-related policy changes backed by the primary executive principals of a centralized council get formally approved within a multi-year window?
membership_rule: Includes formal policy approvals and tax rate standardizations enacted by the federal-state council; excludes proposals dropped prior to formal voting due to total lack of consensus.

cases.name: GST Council 28th Meeting - Rate cuts on consumer items
GST Council 31st Meeting - Rate rationalization on remaining 28% items
GST Council 37th Meeting - Corporate tax alignment and rate adjustments
GST Council 45th Meeting - Correction of inverted duty structure on footwear and textiles
GST Council 48th Meeting - Clarifications on taxation of specific commercial supplies
GST Council 50th Meeting - Imposition of 28% GST on online gaming, casinos, and horse racing
GST Council 53rd Meeting - Tax exemptions on certain services and structural clarifications
GST Council 54th Meeting - Further rate adjustments on research services and medical items

coverage_note: 8 major high-profile tax policy adjustments examined; all instances where executive push met administrative intent resulted in formal Council approval.
known_gaps: Minor procedural delays or deferred agenda items that eventually resurface in subsequent meetings.
validity_reason: The decision-making dynamics, voting structures, and executive dominance of the council remain stable across medium-term political cycles.
